description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it and at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Arwen.
Remove a -1/-1 counter and a +1/+1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat
